english: The AZM Referral Form
Completing the CDD and health facility parts of the AZM referral form.
The AZM referral form
Each CDD team has referral forms with a double carbon copy.
The form tracks the number of children referred to the health facility.
It also tracks the number of children who get to the health facility.
Step — the CDD completes the top section; the health facility worker completes the rest.
To be completed by the CDD (transcribed from image)
Name of child; Beneficiary ID.
Age: 1 11 month: [as printed] or 12- 59 months. Gender: Female or Male.
State, LGA, Ward, Settlement.
Date of referral; Name of health facility referred to.
AZM round (tick): Round 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6.
To be completed by the CDD, continued (transcribed from image)
Reason for referral: Sick, Fever, or Side effect to AZM.
